rules.conflictOrdinance: Miami-Dade County Code Sec. 2-11.1 (Conflict of Interest and Code of Ethics Ordinance); subsection (d) voting conflicts, subsection (i) financial disclosure. https://library.municode.com/fl/miami_-_dade_county/codes/code_of_ordinances?nodeId=PTIIICOOR_CH2AD_ARTIINGE_S2-11.1COINCOET ; PDF text https://ethics.miamidade.gov/library/2016-publications-rqo/sec%20_2_11-1_conflict_of_interest_and_code_of_ethics_ordinance_jan16.pdf
rules.abstentionRule: F.S. 112.3143(3): a county officer may not vote on a measure that would inure to the special private gain or loss of the officer, a principal by whom retained, a relative, or a business associate; must state the nature of the interest before the vote and file a memorandum (Form 8B) within 15 days with the Clerk, which is incorporated into the minutes. https://www.leg.state.fl.us/Statutes/index.cfm?App_mode=Display_Statute&URL=0100-0199/0112/Sections/0112.3143.html ; Form 8B: http://www.ethics.state.fl.us/Documents/Forms/Form%208B.pdf ; county guidance https://ethics.miamidade.gov/voting-conflicts.asp
